name: LOLA topography integration into production surface boundary
purpose: Prove that production particle segments intersect the time-dependent body-fixed LOLA triangulation and meet the frozen D01 control-point, topology, and ray-hit gates.
production_capability: LOLA topography integration into production surface boundary
configuration: Explicit srcMoon/examples/lola_surface.in M2 receipt; eight MPI ranks; no inferred constants.
independent_reference: Independent Python decoder of signed little-endian LDEM_4 DN with detached-label scale, plus topology and radial-intersection invariants.
units: body-fixed radius and errors in m; latitude/longitude in planetocentric positive-east degrees
frame_time_convention: MOON_ME_DE421 body-fixed geometry, LSO particle state, SPICE TDB internally, archive UTC where supplied
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Random seed and MPI/OpenMP layout recorded; stochastic criteria use declared confidence intervals.
procedure: Verify I13 and D01 hashes/readiness; initialize the normal LOLA boundary; audit every face; sample approximately 512 vertices and production BVH radial hits; execute one production-mover terrain crossing per eligible MPI rank; compare sampled radii with independently decoded D01.
metrics: maximum and RMS D01 radius error
acceptance_criteria: max D01 radius error <=50 m; max ray/vertex error <= configured collision distance tolerance; zero degenerate/inward faces; every radial query hits; every fixture rank records a production collision.
expected_pass_result: The declared linked M2 capability is evaluated and every frozen criterion is met.
data_hashes: Recorded in run_manifest.json after package hash verification.
status_semantics: PASS means the full linked criterion ran and passed; FAIL means it ran and missed the criterion; ERROR is infrastructure/parser/corruption; SKIPPED means a prerequisite, capability, configuration, or authoritative input is unavailable.
